scope: FINAL AUTH STATE MACHINE CONSISTENCY REBUILD

constraints_honored.changed_area: frontend auth state machine and auth guards

state_machine_changes.summary: Initial auth status now treats any stored authComplete sessionToken as authenticated, including on /login.
Stored auth state validates only authComplete and sessionToken. user is optional supplemental metadata.
/auth/me refresh is supplemental. If a session token exists, /auth/me failure preserves authenticated status.
Route changes cannot move a token-backed session into unauthenticated/checking state.
Global unauthorized events from background requests do not reset a token-backed session.

race_condition_resolution.login_vs_route_change: sessionTokenRef is set before redirect and route-change handling preserves authenticated status when a token exists.
race_condition_resolution.login_vs_auth_me: login aborts pending session checks and /auth/me cannot override token-backed auth.
race_condition_resolution.background_401_vs_auth_state: background 401 events no longer roll back a token-backed session.
race_condition_resolution.refresh_flicker: stored token initializes authenticated immediately, so refresh does not start in checking state.
